description: Every merge to main runs all seven workflows again, although the pull request head that was merged already passed the same jobs on the identical tree. Merges between 09:25Z and 10:39Z on 2026-11-26 each ran the macOS unit job (445 s), the ubuntu unit job (about 165 s) and the Workspace survival job (about 270 s) again, about 17 runner-minutes of tests per merge, with 0 failures on the main pushes; a merge that changed only .github/workflows/docker-build.yml still ran the full unit suite on two operating systems and the survival job (ubuntu 153 s, macOS 445 s, survival 278 s). The bookkeeping gate (scripts/ci_bookkeeping_gate.py, called as the first step of the unit and stress jobs through .github/actions/bookkeeping-gate/action.yml) decides only for pull_request events and answers 'event-not-pull-request' for every push to main.
goal: On a push to main, the unit and Workspace survival jobs skip their expensive steps when positive evidence shows the pushed commit's tree is identical to the tree of the merged pull request's head commit and that same job (same name and operating system) concluded success on that head commit. The decision lives in a new module scripts/ci_main_push_gate.py (standard library only, Python 3.9 syntax, same Decision and rule-line conventions as the existing gate) and is called from scripts/ci_bookkeeping_gate.py for the push event with at most a few added lines; every other case, every error and every missing piece of evidence runs the full job: no single merged pull request found for the commit, tree mismatch, the head's job not found or not successful, a rerun attempt, and any API error. The skip rule is named main-push-tested-tree and the gate prints it like the other rules. The unit and stress workflows gain a daily schedule trigger so one full run of those jobs per day still tests main regardless of the gate, and gain whatever read permissions the new API calls need (and no write permission). Pull request behaviour of the gate is unchanged. The module line budgets are frozen: do not edit holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json or any budget-check script, and keep every touched module within its current budget.
rationale: Measured on 2026-11-26: roughly 17 runner-minutes of tests per merge to main with no failure on any main push in the window, since the pull request head had already passed the same jobs on the same tree (0 failed unit runs on 44 heads of six pull requests). A tree-equality check keeps the safety net where main moved since the last green head (the trees then differ and the full jobs run), and a daily full run bounds the remaining risk.
acceptance_criteria: For a push to main whose pushed commit has exactly one merged pull request, whose tree equals the tree of that pull request's head commit, and whose head commit has a successful check run for the same job name and operating system, the gate prints the rule main-push-tested-tree and writes skip=true.

Each of these runs the full job (skip=false) with its own named rule: no pull request found for the commit, more than one, a pull request not merged into main, tree mismatch, the head's job missing, in progress or not successful, a rerun attempt, a schedule or workflow_dispatch event, and any API error.
The existing pull request rules, their order and their output lines are unchanged; the existing gate tests still pass.
scripts/ci_main_push_gate.py exists as a new module and scripts/ci_bookkeeping_gate.py grows by no more than 10 lines and stays within its current module budget.

test-unit.yml and test-stress.yml declare a daily schedule trigger, still call the bookkeeping gate first, and keep their jobs, steps, concurrency and every other trigger unchanged apart from any added read-only permission; a wiring test asserts the schedule trigger and the read-only permissions.
The README section on the bookkeeping gate documents the main-push rule, the daily full run and the fail-open behaviour.

All new tests use the existing fake client and opener seams and no network; uv run pytest passes for apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_ci_main_push_gate.py, test_ci_bookkeeping_gate.py, test_ci_bookkeeping_chain.py and test_ci_bookkeeping_wiring.py, and uv run task lint and uv run task lint-docs pass.
